scope: 29 existing repository U4f reference fits; no new experimental data
cause: For first failing Scan_0, substituting only corrected LA into baseline engine produces bit-identical current fit parameters and chi-square. This isolates model migration from optimizer or covariance changes.
contract: Convergence, no objective increase from corrected seed, independent scipy.ndimage convolution and closed GL oracle, exact shared links, legacy center drift <=0.005eV and width/amplitude/area/reduced-chi-square drift <=1%. These are compatibility budgets, not uncertainty or experimental accuracy claims.
